title: DamBreakNet for QGIS
description:
A QGIS plugin that maps the maximum flood after a dam break. It runs DamBreakNet, a hydrograph-conditioned convolutional neural network, with its three trained models, and the LNEC/ANA and HAND methods on the same inputs, then checks each map and gives a triage (rapid map, or check with a 2D model). Trained on dams in Brazil; outside Brazil it translates ESA WorldCover land cover to the MapBiomas classes the model reads, and its accuracy there is untested.
